requirements.landmarks: Every route exposes one identified main landmark and named navigation landmarks.
requirements.accessible_names: Interactive controls, links, maps and data visualizations expose a non-empty accessible name.
requirements.live_regions: Dynamic filter, map and snapshot status surfaces use polite or assertive live regions with atomic updates where needed.
requirements.relationships: aria-controls, aria-labelledby and aria-describedby references resolve to an element in the same route.
requirements.decorative_content: Brand marks, icon glyphs and chart swatches are hidden from the accessibility tree and never receive focus.
requirements.keyboard_surfaces: Menu, map controls and map region paths expose keyboard focus and an announced action or name.
requirements.state_copy: Loading, empty, error, offline, stale and contract-only states are represented by text and data-av-state, not colour alone.

acceptance.method: dependency-free HTML/JS semantic audit plus browser accessibility-tree smoke
